title: Folder import refreshes the work catalog per task through the unindexed FTS delete, so large imports scale quadratically
outcome: Folder import refreshes the work catalog per task through the unindexed FTS delete, so large imports scale quadratically
acceptance: Task-tree/folder import writes catalog search rows for newly imported tasks without a per-task full scan of work_catalog_fts (for example a one-pass empty-slot preflight plus restore-style catalog initialization, as graph loading does), and the comment beside the import's catalog write describes what it actually does
A test counts catalog FTS delete statements (or equivalent) during a multi-task folder import and shows they do not grow with the number of imported tasks
